name: Tony Stark
description: Genius billionaire who built a powered armor suit to fight evil.

name: Steve Rogers
description: Recipient of the Super-Soldier serum, World War II hero, and leader of the Avengers.

name: Bruce Banner
description: Genius scientist who, because of exposure to gamma radiation, transforms into a monster.

name: Thor Odinson
description: The God of Thunder, prince of Asgard, who wields the mystical hammer Mjolnir.

name: Natasha Romanoff
description: Expert spy, athlete, and assassin, trained in the Red Room.

name: Thanos
description: Warlord from Titan who seeks to collect all six Infinity Stones to wipe out half of all life in the universe.

name: Loki Laufeyson
description: The God of Mischief and adopted brother of Thor, known for his deceit and magical abilities.

name: Johann Schmidt
description: Ruthless commander of Hydra and Captain America's archenemy, altered by an imperfect Super-Soldier serum.
